policies.name: CLIENT_SCOPE
policies.applies_to: every request by a person or an agent
policies.rule: The actor must be assigned to the client book it acts on. Out-of-scope requests are refused without revealing whether the book exists.

policies.name: ROLE_AUTHORITY
policies.applies_to: every request by a person or an agent
policies.rule: The actor's role must grant the requested action. Anything not explicitly granted is denied.

policies.name: READ_ONLY
policies.rule: This pilot is read-only. No one, person or agent, can post to a ledger, move money, email a client or change model routes or credentials.

policies.name: REVIEW_DUPLICATE
policies.rule: A possible duplicate charge is never resolved automatically. It goes to a CPA reviewer.

policies.name: MISSING_GL
policies.rule: A bank line with no ledger entry (or the reverse) needs a CPA reviewer. No journal entry is created by LedgerSight.

policies.name: MAKER_CHECKER
policies.rule: The person who proposed a resolution cannot approve it, and agents can never approve.

policies.name: DATA_CLASS
policies.rule: Only synthetic data is accepted until the client-data controls are approved.

policies.name: MODEL_ROUTE
policies.rule: Processing may only use allowlisted model routes. The reconciliation path is deterministic.

policies.name: REVIEW_EXCEPTION
policies.rule: Every other reconciliation exception (partial receipt, missing receipt, unmatched deposit, ambiguous, overpayment) is routed to a CPA reviewer.

policies.name: QUERY_READ_ONLY
policies.rule: Ask LedgerSight answers fixed read-only questions about the open client book. No SQL, no write requests.

policies.name: STATE_TAX_REVIEW
policies.rule: An interstate sale with missing taxability, nexus, registration or date facts goes to a CPA reviewer as a potential tax/nexus review. LedgerSight asserts no tax liability and never computes, files or pays tax.

policies.name: FX_RATE_APPROVAL
policies.rule: A payment in a different currency from its bill is never converted or auto-matched without an approved exchange-rate source. It goes to a CPA reviewer.
